integrity: The proof first establishes that general position sets of size at least three are exactly the independent sets, then computes the independence polynomial by three disjoint spine-selection cases. The general position polynomial differs only by restoring all adjacent two-sets. Strict log-concavity is proved algebraically for the independence-polynomial coefficients and then checked at the three inequalities affected by the degree-two correction. A standalone checker independently enumerates every subset over the tested range.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to square-page book graphs B_r with r at least two.
Longer-cycle books, arbitrary generalized theta graphs, and broader star Cartesian products are not covered.
Finite exhaustive verification over 2 <= r <= 8 is corroborative only.
A differently named or non-indexed exact book-graph polynomial could exist despite targeted searches.
title: Strict log-concavity of general position polynomials of square-page book graphs
